subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted external workspace agent-config discovery, or keep agent registration explicit and prioritize zero-restart explicit agent management?
rationale: The request adds a new config surface, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, precedence rules, and live routing/session semantics that source inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue using central config, `$include`, and `agents.create/update/delete`, and solve most operational pain through hot-load/hot-remove explicit registration before adding glob discovery.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery
options.body: Approve a core discovery contract only after trusted roots, glob bounds, realpath/symlink behavior, validation, precedence, reload semantics, audit/doctor handling, docs, and security proof are specified.

options.title: Reject Core Discovery
options.body: Keep workspace scanning outside core as operator tooling or plugin/ClawHub work unless a smaller missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config, `$include`, and `agents.create/update/delete`, and solve most operational pain through hot-load/hot-remove explicit registration before adding glob discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest history signal for the adjacent model-visible agent discovery surface, while the final choice is a product/security boundary.
